task.title: Registering for a Red Hat Account
task.shortdesc: To use Quay.io, you can register for a Red Hat account on the Red Hat Customer Portal. You create login credentials and provide the required contact information.

context.p: Use the following procedure to register for a Red Hat account for Quay.io.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Red Hat Customer Portal.
In navigation pane, click Log In.
When navigated to the log in page, click Register for a Red Hat Account.
Enter a Red Hat login ID.
Enter the following contact information that is relative to your country or region. For example:
Select and agree to Red Hat’s terms and conditions.
Navigate to Quay.io and log in.
